features.claim: Ankylosaurus had a broad, robust body.
features.quote: It was quadrupedal, with a broad, robust body.
It was quadrupedal, and its hind limbs were longer than its forelimbs.

features.claim: Ankylosaurus had a wide, low skull.
features.quote: It had a wide, low skull, with two horns pointing backward from the back of the head, and two horns below these that pointed backward and down.

features.claim: Ankylosaurus had a beak at the front of its jaws and rows of small, leaf-shaped teeth behind it.
features.quote: The front part of the jaws was covered in a beak, with rows of small, leaf-shaped teeth farther behind it.

features.claim: Ankylosaurus was covered in armor plates, with bony half-rings on its neck.
features.quote: It was covered in armor plates, or osteoderms, with bony half-rings covering the neck, and had a large club on the end of its tail.

features.claim: Ankylosaurus had a large club on the end of its tail.
features.quote: It was covered in armor plates, or osteoderms, with bony half-rings covering the neck, and had a large club on the end of its tail.
Its broad muzzle indicates it was a non-selective browser.

features.claim: Ankylosaurus had a low center of gravity.
features.quote: With its low center of gravity, Ankylosaurus would have been unable to knock down trees like modern elephants do.

features.claim: Ankylosaurus had a heavy club at the end of its tail.
features.quote: This armoured dinosaur had bony plates covering its body and a heavy club at the end of its tail.

features.claim: Ankylosaurus had grinding teeth with a beak at the front.
features.quote: grinding teeth with a beak at the front

not_this.claim: Old pictures show Ankylosaurus squatting and dragging its tail club on the ground, but modern reconstructions show it with a more upright limb posture and its tail held off the ground.
not_this.quote: Many traditional popular depictions show Ankylosaurus in a squatting posture and with a huge tail club being dragged over the ground. Modern reconstructions show the animal with a more upright limb posture and with the tail held off the ground.

not_this.claim: Old pictures show large spines sticking out sideways from the body, but these are not known from Ankylosaurus itself.
not_this.quote: Likewise, large spines projecting sideways from the body (similar to those of nodosaurid ankylosaurs) are present in many traditional depictions, but are not known from Ankylosaurus itself.

not_this.claim: In the Jurassic Park films Ankylosaurus is shown attacking with its tail and running, abilities that paleontologists have criticized as unlikely.
not_this.quote: Ankylosaurus has been featured in the Jurassic Park franchise, where they are depicted as attacking with their tails and running, abilities that have been criticized as unlikely by paleontologists.

debated.claim: The exact placement of the armor plates on the body is unknown.
debated.quote: These have not been found in articulation, so their exact placement on the body is unknown, though inferences can be made based on related animals, and various configurations have been proposed.

debated.claim: The exact arrangement of the neck half-rings is uncertain.
debated.quote: Like other ankylosaurids, Ankylosaurus had cervical half-rings (armor plates on the neck), but these are known only from fragments, making their exact arrangement uncertain.

debated.claim: The structure of much of the skeleton, including most of the pelvis, tail, and feet, is still unknown.
debated.quote: The structure of much of the skeleton of Ankylosaurus, including most of the pelvis, tail, and feet, is still unknown.

debated.claim: Nobody knows exactly how Ankylosaurus' back armour should be arranged.
debated.quote: Even today, nobody knows exactly how Ankylosaurus' back armour should be arranged.
